observations.result: Every language case has validation, lookup/incoming/outgoing for each observed label plus absent label, root admission and context for usable roots. Missing targets fail validation with complete scan coverage; malformed and owner failures make coverage partial. Literal exclusions do not invent facts.

Forward WP-1 implements REQ-1 resolves after collection. Missing REQ-2 retains two backlinks and four total relationships. Duplicate REQ-1 retains both declarations and rejects traversal root admission without losing direct evidence.

Incoming evidence retains unowned/ambiguous owners. Traversal reports one unresolved incident edge; incoming depth-one CASE-3 also reports the unvisited VAL-1 depth boundary. Overall validation fails owner integrity.

Empty allowlist fails four observed edges while graph/query/traversal facts remain the mixed snapshot. Interpretation change yields profile-mismatch. Symbolic bindings distinguish policy identity from analysis identity.

Empty example fails minEntities/entity-count and reports zero-source require-relation as not-applicable; explicit empty policy passes. Unsupported rule/schema fail compilation and identify the field/rule in diagnostics.

Repeated REQ-2 backlinks page as R2/R3/R5 with offsets 1/2/null; exhausted pages stay empty. Empty/unknown filters match none. Depth-zero and two-node bounds are visible. Three cyclic/self edges remain but traversal selects two nodes with canonical R1 predecessor.

After-edit identity rejects earlier selection. Either analysis admission limit returns failure without a snapshot. Post-compilation input mutation leaves identity, interpretation and validation unchanged; JSON copies are rejected as handles. These are expected images, not an executed runtime immutability test.

WP-1 context totals 169 bytes; WP-2 heading/header/row total 127 bytes and three parts. Exact fit admits; 126 bytes or two parts omits whole bundle. Zero budget returns no parts. CRLF/emoji variant preserves exact source offsets and totals 175 context bytes.

Parent context excludes the child paragraph; child includes heading support. Ambiguous definition fragments omit each entity, including both selected owners and zero budget, without creating a source-analysis diagnostic when there is no reference.

Unsupported-node model yields overall indeterminate and partial query metadata; warning-only model yields pass/complete. Both are explicitly injected API states, not parser outputs of the CRLF fixture.
